content.text: Digital creators often face significant obstacles when trying to sell their products online, especially in regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable. In countries such as Nigeria and Zimbabwe, traditional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-14|payment]] gateways can create barriers to commerce, leaving creators to seek alternatives. This breakdown focuses on using GitHub Pages for free digital product store hosting, providing a robust solution without the high fees associated with platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% on every sale. With NOWPayments, you can process transactions at just 0.5%, enabling you to retain more of your earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages serves as a powerful solution for hosting your digital product store without reliance on conventional payment platforms. It allows you to create a professional online presence at zero cost, utilizing GitHub's [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-6|The Full]]. This approach matters because it empowers creators to maintain full control over their products and profits. By leveraging a system where you host your site and handle payments via cryptocurrency, you eliminate the risks associated with financial isolation and platform dependency. This is fundamental for anyone looking to operate independently in an increasingly digital economy.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages setup for a digital store utilizes a combination of free tools. GitHub Pages provides reliable hosting, while Google Apps Script or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-first-principles-4|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Workers can manage backend processes, such as order fulfillment and product delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto transactions effortlessly, verifying payments with a minimal fee. This infrastructure operates on a decentralized model, meaning you are not just renting space; you own your entire stack. This ownership translates to a direct connection with your customers and complete control over your data and assets.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is particularly designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors fail to provide adequate service. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or software, this infrastructure allows you to bypass the limitations imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe. It is built for those who want to retain maximum revenue and autonomy. The architecture caters specifically to creators in countries like Ghana, Kenya, and Venezuela, where access to traditional payment solutions is restricted, enabling them to thrive in the digital marketplace.
GitHub Pages offers free and reliable hosting for your digital store.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this digital product store setup include GitHub Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for payment processing, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for secure file delivery. Each component plays a crucial role in the overall functionality. GitHub Pages enables fast and reliable access to your site, while NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, all without KYC requirements. For file storage and delivery, services like Google Drive ensure that your products are accessible to customers immediately upon purchase, enhancing the buying experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own digital product store using GitHub Pages, start by creating a GitHub account and setting up your repository. Next, upload your product files and configure your site using a template from the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which provides all necessary blueprints. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate backend processes. Sign up for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions seamlessly. Finally, ensure your site is optimized for user experience, testing the entire flow from product purchase to file delivery.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize GitHub Pages to host your store and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination allows you to operate independently and retain a larger share of your sales revenue. For example, with 100 sales per month at $97 each, you would save $921 in fees compared to using a platform like Gumroad.
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all the tools you need to create and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. This solution is ideal for those seeking to operate outside the restrictions imposed by traditional payment platforms. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?
You can sell an ebook by using GitHub Pages for hosting and integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. This allows you to accept cryptocurrency directly, bypassing traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

Utilizing GitHub Pages in combination with NOWPayments is the best way to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees. This setup retains more of your earnings compared to options like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own store on GitHub Pages and processing payments through NOWPayments. This approach eliminates reliance on third-party platforms.
What are the transaction fees associated with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of just 0.5% per transaction, significantly less than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This allows you to retain more revenue from each sale.
How quickly can I set up my digital store?
You can set up your digital store relatively quickly, typically within 48 hours, especially if you use the templates and blueprints provided in the Complete Builder Kit.
